tasks.question: What is the 'Rule of Thirds' in slide design?
options: Dividing the slide into a 3x3 grid to place elements

tasks.question: Which font type is generally easier to read on a screen?
What is 'Visual Hierarchy'?
options: Arranging elements to show their importance

tasks.question: Why should you use high-quality images?
What is 'Consistency' in slide design?
options: Using a different font on every slide
Using the same colors, fonts, and styles throughout

tasks.question: What is the purpose of a 'Title Slide'?
options: To introduce the topic and the speaker

tasks.question: What is 'Contrast'?
options: The difference between elements like light and dark

tasks.question: How many main ideas should typically be on one slide?
What is 'Clutter'?
options: Too many unnecessary elements on a slide

tasks.question: Which of these is a Sans Serif font?
What is the benefit of using a dark background with light text?
options: It can be easier to read in a dark room

tasks.question: What is 'Alignment'?
options: How text and images are positioned relative to each other

tasks.question: What does 'Less is More' mean in design?
options: Use more slides with less content
Simplicity often leads to better communication

tasks.question: What is the '7x7 Rule'?
options: No more than 7 lines per slide and 7 words per line

tasks.question: What is 'Proximity' in design?
options: How close the speaker is to the screen

tasks.question: Why are icons useful on slides?
options: They represent ideas quickly and visually

tasks.question: What is a 'Color Palette'?
options: A selected set of colors used consistently

tasks.question: What is 'Focal Point'?
options: The area where the viewer's eye is drawn first

tasks.question: Which is better for a presentation: many slides with little text or few slides with lots of text?
options: Few slides with lots of text

tasks.question: What should you do with a very complex chart?
options: Put it all on one slide
Simplify it or break it into smaller parts

tasks.question: What is 'Balance' in layout?
options: Distributing elements evenly on the slide

tasks.question: What is 'White Space' also called?
What is the main goal of slide design?
options: To support the speaker's message clearly

tasks.question: Which color combination is usually high contrast?
What is 'Repetition' in design?
options: Repeating visual elements to create unity

tasks.text: Good design helps your audience understand.
Sans serif fonts like Arial are easy to read.
Contrast makes important elements stand out.
The 7x7 rule limits text on a single slide.
Negative space prevents slides from looking cluttered.
Alignment creates a clean and organized look.
Visual hierarchy guides the viewer's eye.
Use high-quality images for a better look.
Simplify complex information for your slides.
